name: NotFair
author: yutingzhong

sections.description:
Let your own AI agent—Claude, ChatGPT, or Codex—manage your WordPress website through NotFair.

NotFair MCP is a universal MCP connector for Google Ads, Meta Ads, X Ads,
LinkedIn Ads, Reddit Ads, Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, GoHighLevel,
and WordPress. Connect once and manage your platforms with your AI agent.

NotFair SEO lets you publish and update articles and featured images directly
on your website.

Learn more at notfair.co.

An account at https://notfair.co is required. The service provides workspace access,
MCP client connections, orchestration and SEO publishing. Service plans may be paid.
The plugin has no local paid feature gates.

Configure the integration token from your NotFair workspace. Saving the token and
enabling MCP or SEO authorizes the service to access the corresponding site data.
MCP requests operate with the approving administrator’s permissions. Disable either
integration independently. Tokens are never displayed publicly or rotated automatically.

External service

Service: NotFair (https://notfair.co).
Data: requested site information, content, media, settings and supported integration
records are returned to NotFair when an authorized user invokes a tool. Mutation
requests contain the requested changes. NotFair records operation metadata for audit
and product analytics. The plugin does not send background usage telemetry.
Public HTTPS media URLs are fetched only upon an explicit import request. Plugin,
theme and core management use WordPress.org distribution services.
Terms: https://notfair.co/terms
Privacy: https://notfair.co/privacy

Capabilities and limits

Domain tools support content editing, literal replacement, Gutenberg blocks, menus,
revision recovery, media import, SEO fields, redirects and diagnostics. Optional
adapters require their corresponding plugin. Tool schemas describe supported fields.
No arbitrary PHP execution, executable file editing or remote script publishing is
provided. Standalone pages accept sanitized HTML with inline styles. Scripts and
embedded executable content are rejected. Existing integration tokens and the legacy
installed basename remain compatible. Some third-party changes cannot be undone.

Bundled assets

DM Sans and JetBrains Mono are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Their license files are included in assets/fonts. NotFair’s original code and
logo are distributed under GPLv2 or later. The service terms do not override
the license of the plugin code.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate NotFair.
  2. Add your website in your NotFair workspace and copy its integration token.
  3. Open Settings > NotFair, paste the token and enable the integrations you need.
  4. Save, return to NotFair and verify the connection.
sections.faq:
Can MCP and SEO be enabled separately?

Yes. Disabling or removing one integration does not remove the other.

Does this plugin execute arbitrary PHP?

No. Version 2 removes this capability and general executable-file management.
sections.changelog:
2.0.2

  • Load core update helpers only when needed and remove an unnecessary internal core include.
  • Preserve existing SEO publishing endpoints and integration credentials.

2.0.1

  • Align the translation text domain with the assigned directory slug, notfair.

2.0.0

  • Renamed to NotFair.
  • Added domain tools and installed-plugin adapters.
  • Removed arbitrary PHP execution and general executable-file management.
  • Restricted HTML publishing to non-executable markup.

1.6.2

  • Added a product introduction in settings.
